evidence.quote: As mentioned, only thin (<10 nm) aqueous-solution-processed s MoO3, s GeO2, s V2O5 and s CrO3 films could be prepared since these TMO materials have limited solubility in water. The film thickness and coverage could be improved by repetitive coating (more than twice). Under the optimized coating process (three times), uniform s MoO3, s GeO2, s V2O5 and s CrO3 films could be obtained on the ITO substrates. The corresponding perovskite solar cells approached PCE over 12% (ESI, Fig. S4 and Table S1 † ), which is comparable to the PEDOT:PSS-based device.

unresolved_notes: Scan direction was not reported for the tabulated J-V observations. The shared J-V protocol was AM 1.5 G solar irradiation at 100 mW cm -2 using a programmable Keithley 2400 source meter (span-d2613e595150).

The main-text and supporting-information optimized s V2O5 PSC rows report the same JSC and VOC but different FF/PCE values: 71% and 13.26% in Table 2 versus 0.68 and 12.75% for the three-coating row in Table S1 (span-2fae8b106e3c; span-bcf501671d5d). They are retained as separate measured-device records.

The main-text PEDOT:PSS-MoO3 (4 : 1) row reports 15.66% PCE, whereas Table S2 reports 15.10% for the 4:1 row (span-513d7fd731c1; span-3fbfca881ec8). The main-text and SI rows are therefore not linked as one physical device.

The main-text PEDOT:PSS-GeO2 (4 : 1) row reports 16.15% PCE, whereas Table S2 reports 15.15% for the 4:1 row (span-5c57a2f84d70; span-4e16a94b45b9). The main-text and SI rows are therefore not linked as one physical device.

Several main-table and supporting-table rows have identical labels and outcomes, but the source does not explicitly establish that they are the same physical specimen. They remain separate records rather than being linked by numerical coincidence.

The supporting-information shorthand stacks omit Bphen relative to the main-text PSC stack and write the absorber differently (span-d5ecaaef0174; span-2154b417470e). The main-text complete stack was used for the families; the SI shorthand was not treated as proof of different families.

The aged 150h PEDOT:PSS+V2O5 and PEDOT:PSS perovskite cells in Figure S8 were prepared for cross-sectional SEM/EDX and have no photovoltaic aging outcome in the supplied evidence; they were excluded as characterization specimens (span-5f97de31120a).

The ITO/TMOs/PTB7:PC71BM/MoO3/Al hole-dominant devices were used for impedance characterization and were not treated as photovoltaic device families or performance devices (span-60c0b4f8fbe1; span-3410ee858834).

The supplied evidence gives a 100 nm thickness jointly for Al or Ag. The value was assigned item-specifically to Al in the OSC stacks and Ag in the main-text PSC stacks because those electrode identities are explicitly established by the respective complete stacks (span-a944a002ea4e; span-ce9383b07308).

The shared J-V conditions—1 sun, AM 1.5 G irradiation at 100 mW cm -2, and the Keithley 2400 source meter—are explicitly reported in span-d2613e595150, but PerformanceObservation has no field for measurement conditions or instrument. They were not misclassified as outcome metrics.

The tables report one parameter row per HTL or fabrication setting but do not explicitly establish whether repeated equal rows, particularly the main-table and supplementary PEDOT:PSS-V2O5 2:1 results, came from the same physical device. Existing device and observation identities were therefore not merged or removed.

The source globally describes MoO3, GeO2, V2O5 and CrO3 as thin films in span-0bf55ed8d70b, but the family-specific spans cited by the flagged layer records do not themselves contain the raw phrase. No family replacement was made solely to propagate that general typography fragment.
